Heavy rains in Haryana cause house collapse, two women dead

Heavy rainfall in Haryana has led to a house collapse in Gohana, Sonipat district. The incident resulted in the deaths of two women, identified as a devarani and jethani, who were trapped under the debris. The continuous downpour is causing significant disruption in the region.
